name: Anathoth
title: Son of Becher in the line of Benjamin
summary: Anathoth was one of Becher's sons in the genealogy of Benjamin. The name is also borne by a Levitical city in the land of Benjamin, which later became known as the hometown of the prophet Jeremiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Anathoth is listed among Becher's sons, heads of their families in the tribe of Benjamin.
